Name: Let Me Decorate
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
I love decorating in this game, and I've always found myself wanting to place carpets and couches outside, and I have no clue why we can't. Suuuureee technically they would get soggy in the rain but it's a game so... they won't. 

I went ahead and made a good few pieces of the furniture set into a Custom Furniture tilesheet so that you can now place them outside. WOOO Decoration! (I could have probably edited the info with Content Patcher but I am not a big brain modder so you get what you get)

[b]A couple notes:

Due to CF limitations you can't really place the chairs side by side like you can with the normal furniture - it rotates the actual hit box instead of the furniture image itself and I can't really fix that. 

Another CF limitation makes it so that sitting on the chairs sideways looks funny so that also doesn't work - but at least you can sit on the forward facing ones! 

This is my first mod so I have no clue if I did something wrong, but I tested everything so it should be fine! 


[/b]If you have any other furniture you want made into outside placeable things that I missed just let me know!


Huge thanks to Elizabeth who wrote this python converter code for DGA!
[url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/FurnitureConverter]Link to Converter[/url]
